invariants.name: cannot_write_production_policy
invariants.statement: No module writes to morrison_governance configuration or source.

invariants.name: cannot_modify_ontology_versions
invariants.statement: Ontology versions are source constants; LB-0 has no setter for them.

invariants.name: cannot_transition_candidate_to_enforced
invariants.statement: The promotion lifecycle refuses APPROVED / SHADOW / ENFORCED.

invariants.name: cannot_bypass_approval_verification
invariants.statement: No approval artifact is constructed, signed or verified anywhere in LB-0.

invariants.name: cannot_invoke_provider_actions
invariants.statement: No execution or provider surface is imported or called.

invariants.name: cannot_disable_runtime_governance
invariants.statement: The production ruleset fingerprint is unchanged across a full run.
